summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Driver CRUD functionality. All 18 backend API tests passed. Frontend CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) all working correctly. License expiry warnings display properly with visual indicators.

integration_issues.issue: When backend returns validation error (422), the error object is rendered as React child causing runtime error. Error message: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, ctx})'

action_items: Fix error handling in frontend toast to properly display validation error messages instead of rendering the error object directly
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend error handling in Drivers.js line 96 should extract error message string from validation error response instead of passing the entire error object to toast
